system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu while the Brood Mother and its Broodling’s are active. You draw a seal across your body in golden silk before drawing blood and pressing it into the ground release a pulse of arachnid pheromones. All active Broodling’s begins to hear you, listening to you and your directives.

For the duration all active Broodling’s no longer attack autonomously, and instead act as part of you commanding the Brood Mother, following separate commands you give, each Broodling acting independently if you dictate. Additionally, your Brood Mother and Broodling’s gain the Web Rain special ability. When you use this ability, both the Brood Mother and Broodling’s act on this single command at the same time.

Web Rain. All currently active Broodling’s move their full movement towards a single creature, and then the Brood Mother makes 2 Web String attacks targeting the same creature. For every Broodling that ends their movement within 5 feet of the target creature, they each make a Bite attack. If a creature is Bleeding or Weakened, the Broodling’s deal +4 damage to the target creature.
